hard_gates.name: Authoritative requirements traceability
hard_gates.criterion: All Must requirements are IMPLEMENTED_TESTED or have an approved, time-bounded external waiver.

hard_gates.name: Live PostgreSQL migration validation
hard_gates.criterion: All migrations execute successfully on a clean production-equivalent PostgreSQL instance and rollback/recovery is demonstrated.

hard_gates.name: Live OpenWA transport validation
hard_gates.criterion: Real sessions prove pairing, text/media send, inbound events, sent/delivered/read acknowledgements and uncertain-outcome handling.
hard_gates.evidence: VPS and genuine WhatsApp sessions required

hard_gates.name: Capacity and performance evidence
hard_gates.criterion: 10M-contact query tests, campaign-ledger scale tests and measured per-session sustainable capacity are complete.

hard_gates.name: Security assurance
hard_gates.criterion: Threat model, dependency/container scans, secret scan, SAST and independent penetration test have no unresolved critical/high findings.

hard_gates.name: Backup and disaster recovery proof
hard_gates.criterion: Encrypted backups, point-in-time recovery, object restore and OpenWA session recovery are tested against agreed RPO/RTO.

hard_gates.name: Operational readiness
hard_gates.criterion: Monitoring, alerting, runbooks, on-call ownership, incident process and maintenance controls are exercised.

hard_gates.name: Frontend workflow completion
hard_gates.criterion: All required UI/UX workflows and exceptional states are implemented, accessible and permission-aware.
